title: check-debt-ratchets
responsibility: Compares layer allowlist edges, reuse findings, and direct temporary-directory calls against Git-base inventories, failing when these debt measures grow.

inputs.name: layerRatchet.before
inputs.description: Baseline allowlist edges that main() reads from the edges array of eslint.layer-allowlist.json at the comparison base ref, and a current key absent from this list is reported as a new upward import. Edges are keyed as from -> to using only their from and to fields, so repeated pairs count once and todo does not affect the result.

examples.todo: Route the report summary through the view model.
Move the date formatter into src/core.
Route the report summary through the view model.

inputs.name: layerRatchet.after
inputs.description: Current allowlist edges that main() reads from the edges array of eslint.layer-allowlist.json in the current working directory, where each key absent from the baseline is reported as a new upward import and fails the check. A key present only in the baseline is returned in removed and never fails the check.

examples.todo: Move the date formatter into src/core.
Split the invoice table out of the domain layer.

inputs.name: reuseRatchet.before
inputs.description: Baseline reuse finding counts keyed by path, read by main() from eslint.reuse-baseline.json at the comparison base ref. A path missing from this object is reported as added whenever it appears in after, and the before total sums every count here.

inputs.name: reuseRatchet.after
inputs.description: Current reuse finding counts keyed by path, read by main() from eslint.reuse-baseline.json in the current working directory. A path missing here counts as zero, so a baseline path with a count above zero is reported as reduced, and any path whose count rose above its baseline is reported as added.

inputs.name: mkdtempCallCount.source
inputs.description: TypeScript source text of one test file, read from the working tree or from a base-ref git blob and parsed as temporary-fixture.ts with the latest script target. Only mkdtemp or mkdtempSync calls are counted when imported by name from node:fs, node:fs/promises, fs, or fs/promises, or reached through a namespace import of one of those modules; default imports, require calls, and names with no such import are ignored.

inputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet.before
inputs.description: Baseline direct temporary-directory call counts for each .ts or .tsx file under test/ at the base ref, built by temporaryCallBase with three named inherited fixtures raised to at least one call. A test file missing here counts as zero, so its first direct call is reported as growth unless the file is the shared helper.

inputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet.after
inputs.description: Current direct temporary-directory call counts for each .ts or .tsx file under test/ listed by git ls-files, covering tracked files and untracked files that standard ignore rules do not exclude. Each listed file is read from disk, so a listed path that cannot be read makes the run throw instead of being counted.

inputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet.helperPath
inputs.description: Test-file path of the shared temporary helper, matched exactly against the after counts: its count skips the ordinary growth check but is reported when it exceeds one direct mkdtemp call. Defaults to test/support/temporary.ts when omitted.

outputs.name: layerRatchet
outputs.type: { before: number; after: number; added: string[]; removed: string[] }
outputs.description: Unique from -> to edge counts for the baseline and current allowlists, plus sorted added and removed edge keys. main() exits with failure when added is non-empty; removed is returned but neither printed nor checked by main().

outputs.name: reuseRatchet
outputs.type: { before: number; after: number; added: string[]; reduced: string[] }
outputs.description: Total finding counts for each object, plus sorted added entries and sorted reduced entries, both in the form path: before -> after. main() prints and exits with failure for added entries only; reduced is returned but neither printed nor checked by main().

outputs.name: mkdtempCallCount
outputs.description: Number of recognized direct mkdtemp or mkdtempSync calls in the source, including nested calls, and 0 when no such name is imported. Each file's value becomes its entry in the base or current TemporaryCallBaseline map.

outputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet
outputs.type: { before: number; after: number; added: string[] }
outputs.description: Total direct call counts for the before and after maps, plus sorted added entries: path: old -> new for a grown file, or a shared-helper line when the helper has more than one direct call. main() exits with failure when added is non-empty.

added: test/support/temporary.ts: shared helper has 2 direct mkdtemp calls (maximum 1)

errors.name: Debt baseline inspection failure
errors.description: Thrown when a git command run through execFileSync fails, when readFileSync cannot read the current allowlist, the current reuse baseline, or a listed test file, or when JSON.parse throws a SyntaxError on the base or current allowlist or reuse baseline. When baseRef returns no commit, main() does not throw: it prints the unavailable message, sets process.exitCode to 1, and returns.
